findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:157-169 define `q2ESigma`/`yESigma` and only `q2ESigma_pos`; grep for `q2ESigma|yESigma|ESigmaMethodData` across `EpsilonEridani/` matches `AccessMethods.lean` alone.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma q2ESigma_eq_q2Electron (d : ESigmaMethodData V) : d.q2ESigma = d.electronData.q2Electron := (rfl)` and `@[simp] lemma yESigma_eq_ySigma (d : ESigmaMethodData V) : d.yESigma g = d.sigmaData.ySigma g := (rfl)`; or, since both are pure projections and nothing in the repo consumes them, drop the two aliases and `q2ESigma_pos` and let consumers write `d.electronData.q2Electron` / `d.sigmaData.ySigma g`.
findings.issue: `yESigma` carries no characteristic lemma at all, so a consumer must unfold the definition before `ySigma_eq_yInel` (line 136) applies; `q2ESigma` likewise has no `_eq_q2Electron` restatement (only `q2ESigma_pos`, whose own proof unfolds with `rw [q2ESigma]`). Every other definition in the file got its characteristic lemma in this PR.

findings.evidence: `variable (g : Bilin V)` at AccessMethods.lean:42 is the only binding of `g` in scope at line 163; `q2Sigma`/`ySigma` at lines 117/123 instead bind `(g_met : Bilin V)` after `d`.
findings.fix: Give `yESigma` its own trailing explicit parameter, `def yESigma (d : ESigmaMethodData V) (g_met : Bilin V) : ℝ := d.sigmaData.ySigma g_met`, matching `ySigma`.
findings.issue: `yESigma` silently picks up the section variable `g` (line 42), so its exposed signature is `yESigma (g : Bilin V) (d : ESigmaMethodData V)` — the metric precedes the record, while the sibling `q2Sigma`/`ySigma` (lines 117, 123) take `g_met` after the record and `q2ESigma` takes none. Three different metric conventions in one namespace chain.

summary: The renames, the Prop/instance-binder changes and the Lie-algebra and gamma-matrix lemma replacements leave a clean canonical surface with no compatibility residue. The one gap is the reworked eSigma layer: `q2ESigma` and `yESigma` are plain projection aliases exposed with no lemma tying them to the methods they take from, so `yESigma` cannot be connected to `ySigma`/`yInel` without unfolding.
